name: Shield
duration: until the start of your next turn
desc: You raise a magical shield of force that grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. You can use the Shield Block reaction with this shield (Hardness 5). The spell ends if you use Shield Block, and the shield is destroyed after blocking if the damage is high enough. You can't have more than one shield spell active.
higherLevel: The Hardness increases by 5 at 3rd rank, and by 5 again every 2 ranks thereafter.

pf2e.heighten: The Hardness increases by 5 at 3rd rank and every 2 ranks thereafter.

name: Electric Arc
desc: An arc of lightning jumps from one target to another. Each of up to two creatures within range must attempt a basic Reflex save. The spell deals 2d4 electricity damage.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 1d4 for each rank above 1.

name: Telekinetic Projectile
desc: You hurl a nearby object, or conjure a ghostly one, as a ranged attack against a creature. On a hit, you deal 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, depending on the object. A critical hit deals double damage.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 1d6 for each rank above 1.

name: Ignition
desc: You spark a flame at a creature or object. Make a spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 2d4 fire damage (doubled on a critical hit, plus 1d4 persistent fire). If you are adjacent to the target, you can instead deal 2d6 fire damage (and 2d4 persistent fire on a critical hit).
higherLevel: The initial damage increases by 1d4 (or 1d6 melee) per rank above 1.

pf2e.heighten: Initial damage +1d4 (or +1d6 melee) per rank above 1.

name: Guidance
duration: until the start of your next turn
desc: You whisper a hint of insight to a willing creature. Once during the duration, the target can roll 1d6 and add it to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

name: Light
desc: The object you touch glows with magical light, shedding bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light to 40 feet). If you target a worn or carried object, the creature holding it can use an Interact action to suppress or resume the light.
higherLevel: The radius of bright light increases by 5 feet (and dim by 10) at 3rd rank, and every 2 ranks thereafter.

name: Detect Magic
desc: You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You learn whether any magic is within the emanation, and you can choose to learn the school of the highest-rank effect, or the location of an obvious magical aura. The spell can penetrate most barriers but is blocked by 3 feet of wood or dirt, 1 foot of stone, an inch of metal, or a thin sheet of lead.

name: Prestidigitation
desc: You perform a simple magical trick: cook or lift a light, cool or warm an object, create a brief sensory effect, clean or soil an object, kindle or snuff a small flame, or produce a small object that lasts until the end of your next turn. Each effect has tight limits (typically 1 pound, a 1-foot cube, or a faint sensory impression).

name: Heal
desc: You channel positive energy to heal the living or damage undead. 1 action: touch a willing living creature or undead to restore/deal 1d8 Hit Points. 2 actions: range 30 feet, 1d8. 3 actions: 30-foot emanation, 1d8 to all living and undead in the area. Undead attempt a basic Fortitude save against the damage.
higherLevel: The healing or damage increases by 1d8 per rank above 1.

name: Harm
desc: You channel void energy to hurt the living or heal undead. 1 action: touch, 1d8 void damage (or healing to undead). 2 actions: 30 feet. 3 actions: 30-foot emanation. Living creatures take a basic Fortitude save.
higherLevel: The damage or healing increases by 1d8 per rank above 1.

name: Bless
desc: Blessings fill the area. You and all allies in the emanation gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls. Once per round, starting the round after you cast bless, you can Sustain to increase the emanation's radius by 10 feet, to a maximum of 50 feet.

name: Fear
desc: You plant fright in a creature. It attempts a Will save. Critical success: unaffected and temporarily immune for 1 minute. Success: frightened 1. Failure: frightened 2. Critical failure: frightened 3 and fleeing for 1 round.
higherLevel: At 3rd rank you can target up to 5 creatures.

name: Force Barrage
desc: You fire darts of force that automatically hit. For each action spent, you send one dart, each dealing 1d4+1 force damage. You choose targets as you fire; a creature can be hit by multiple darts. This spell was Magic Missile in earlier printings.
higherLevel: You fire one additional dart for each extra action, and when heightened the darts increase: at 3rd rank each dart deals 2d4+2, and every 2 ranks thereafter another 1d4+1.

pf2e.heighten: Extra darts scale with rank (3rd: 2d4+2 each, +1d4+1 per 2 ranks).

name: Hydraulic Push
desc: A blast of water slams a creature. Make a spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage and you can push it 5 feet. On a critical hit, double damage and push 10 feet.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 2d6 per rank above 1.

name: Grim Tendrils
desc: Tendrils of darkness deal 2d4 slashing damage and 1d4 persistent bleed to living creatures in a 30-foot line. Each creature attempts a basic Fortitude save.
higherLevel: The slashing damage increases by 2d4 per rank above 1.

name: Sleep
desc: Each creature in a 5-foot burst attempts a Will save. Critical success: unaffected. Success: slowed 1 for 1 round. Failure: falls unconscious (sleeping) for 1 minute and can be woken by a successful DC 5 flat check when damaged, or automatically by an ally's Interact. Critical failure: as failure, and the flat check is DC 8.

name: Invisibility
desc: The target creature or object becomes invisible. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that action. An invisible creature has the concealed condition against anyone who can't see it; the GM can allow a Seek to reduce this.
higherLevel: 4th rank: the spell doesn't end when the target uses a hostile action.

pf2e.heighten: 4th: hostile actions no longer end the spell.

name: Dispel Magic
desc: You attempt to counteract a spell or magical effect on a creature, unattended object, or area. Use your counteract modifier against the effect's counteract DC and rank. On a success, the effect ends (or is suppressed, for lasting magic items, as determined by the GM).

name: Resist Energy
desc: Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. The target gains resistance 5 to that damage type.
higherLevel: 4th rank: resistance 10, or you can affect two targets with resistance 5. 7th rank: resistance 15, or two targets at 10, or four at 5.

name: Fireball
desc: A bead of fire streaks to a point you choose and blossoms into a 20-foot burst. Each creature in the area takes 6d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 2d6 per rank above 3.

name: Haste
desc: Magic speeds the target up, granting the quickened condition. It can use the extra action each turn only to Strike or Stride.
higherLevel: 7th rank: you can target up to 6 creatures.

name: Slow
desc: You hinder a creature's speed. It attempts a Fortitude save. Critical success: unaffected. Success: slowed 1 for 1 round. Failure: slowed 1 for 1 minute. Critical failure: slowed 2 for 1 minute.
higherLevel: 6th rank: up to 10 creatures.

name: Lightning Bolt
desc: A stroke of lightning deals 4d12 electricity damage to each creature in a 120-foot line, with a basic Reflex save.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 1d12 per rank above 3.

name: Heroism
desc: The target gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks.
higherLevel: 6th rank: the bonus is +2. 9th rank: the bonus is +3.

name: Fly
desc: The target gains a fly Speed equal to its land Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.
higherLevel: 7th rank: the duration is 1 hour.

name: Translocate
desc: You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing or holding from your current space to a clear space you can see within range. If the destination is occupied or otherwise invalid, the spell fails. This spell was Dimension Door in earlier printings.
higherLevel: 5th rank: the range is 1 mile. You don't need line of sight, but you must have been there before.

pf2e.heighten: 5th: 1 mile, no line of sight required if you've been there.

name: Phantasmal Killer
desc: You create a nightmare image only the target can see. It attempts a Will save. Critical success: unaffected. Success: 4d6 mental damage. Failure: 8d6 mental damage and frightened 2. Critical failure: 12d6 mental damage, frightened 2, and fleeing for 1 round.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 2d6 (success), 4d6 (failure), and 6d6 (critical failure) per rank above 4.

name: Cone of Cold
desc: Icy wind howls through a 60-foot cone, dealing 10d6 cold damage with a basic Reflex save.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 2d6 per rank above 5.

name: Disintegrate
desc: A thin green ray attempts to unmake a creature or unattended object. Make a spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 12d10 damage (basic Fortitude; on a critical failure, the creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points). A critical hit on the attack roll doubles the damage before the save. An object takes the same damage with no save; if reduced to 0 HP it is turned to fine powder.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 2d10 per rank above 6.

name: Mask of Terror
desc: The target's visage becomes terrifying. Each creature that sees the target must attempt a Will save. On a failure it becomes frightened 2 (frightened 3 and fleeing for 1 round on a critical failure). A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune for 1 minute. Once a creature has been affected, it need not save again against this casting.

name: Polar Ray
desc: A ray of utter cold streaks from your finger. Make a spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 10d8 cold damage. On a critical hit, double damage and the target is drained 2.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 2d8 per rank above 8.

name: Meteor Swarm
desc: Four meteors crash into four 10-foot bursts you choose within range (bursts can overlap). Each creature in a burst takes 6d10 bludgeoning damage and 14d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save. A creature in more than one burst saves only once and takes the damage only once.

name: Wish
desc: You speak aloud a wish and attempt to bring it into being. The GM decides the result. Typical uses duplicate a spell of 9th rank or lower, undo a recent misfortune, or create a similar powerful but bounded effect. A wish that is too greedy, vague, or world-breaking can fail, twist, or cost you.
